verdict.rationale: Paddle's hosted MCP server explicitly lets agents "investigate failed payments and resolve billing issues" and "configure webhooks", and real-time webhooks support monitoring. Retries and dunning are mostly Paddle-automated: up to seven retries over 30 days, or Retain's Tactical Retries and email notifications configured in settings. There is no evidence an agent can trigger a retry or send dunning outreach through the API, and Retain cannot be tested in sandbox. Missing for 10: documented failed-payment webhook events, API endpoints for agent-initiated retries or dunning outreach, sandbox testability of Retain, independent or hands-on corroboration.
